name: Firebolt
description: Fire a fast bolt for 2.2 times flame damage.

name: Cinder Fan
description: Fire three flames, each dealing 1.1 times flame damage.

name: Backdraft
description: Blast nearby enemies for 1.3 times damage and push them back.

name: Ember Shield
description: Gain a shield worth 25% of maximum health for 5 seconds.

name: Flame Lance
description: Fire a piercing flame for 3 times flame damage.

name: Flame Ring
description: Strike nearby enemies for 2.4 times flame damage.

name: Inferno
description: Burn nearby foes once per second for 4 seconds. Each pulse deals flame damage.

name: Sunburst
description: Strike your aimed enemy and nearby foes for 4 times flame damage.

name: Cleave
description: A quick sweep hits nearby enemies. Short cooldown and low damage per cast.

name: Shield Bash
description: Drive forward for 1.7x damage, stun the first target, and briefly brace.

name: Charge
description: Rush through enemies for 1.6x damage and stun them.

name: Whirlwind
description: A full-circle sweep deals 2.2 times weapon damage to nearby enemies.

name: Iron Guard
description: Brace for 3s, reducing incoming damage by 60%.

name: Shockwave Stomp
description: Slam the ground for 1.5x damage and heavy knockback all around.

name: Warcry
description: Draw nearby enemies toward you for 6 seconds, helping protect your allies.

name: Execution
description: A crushing 4x strike that executes normal enemies below 20% HP.

name: Volley
description: Fan of arrows — up to 5 enemies, 1.4x each. Applies your element once each.

name: Piercing Shot
description: One shot through a line — 2.2x first (−10% its armor), 1.5x rest.

name: Tumble
description: Roll backward with brief invulnerability and fire a parting shot for 75% weapon damage.

name: Shadowstrike
description: Dash through a target (2.0x) and appear behind it; tap again within 1s to return.

name: Spike Trap
description: Place a trap for 5 seconds that repeatedly damages and slows enemies inside.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Become briefly invulnerable and slow nearby enemies with smoke.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark one enemy: you deal +18% and +10% crit to it for 8s.

name: Death Mark
description: Mark up to 5 enemies — they explode for 1.8x on death.

name: Elemental Bolt
description: Fire a quick elemental bolt. Short cooldown and low damage per cast.

name: Elemental Beam
description: Fire a piercing elemental lance for 2x damage through every target.

name: Blink
description: Teleport forward and become untouchable during the displacement.

name: Nova
description: Detonate a 1.4x freezing burst that slows nearby enemies.

name: Gravity Well
description: Create an implosion that pulls enemies inward and deals 1.3x damage.

name: Rune Barrier
description: Create a shield that absorbs 35% of max HP.

name: Attunement
description: Create a damaging storm for 4 seconds. For 10 seconds, your skills cycle through different elements. Your equipped weapon stays unchanged.

name: Elemental Overload
description: Release a massive 3.4x elemental explosion around your target.

name: Reap
description: A quick scythe sweep damages nearby enemies and restores health when it hits.

name: Soul Cleave
description: Send a spectral scythe wave outward for 2.1x damage.

name: Shadow Step
description: Dash through shadow and become briefly untouchable.

name: Wraith Form
description: Become spectral for 3s: faster movement and 65% damage reduction.

name: Void Pull
description: Implode nearby enemies toward a central point and stagger them.

name: Soul Tether
description: Bind enemies in front of you, rooting them for 2.5s.

name: Soul Siphon
description: A powerful draining sweep damages nearby enemies and heals 5% of your maximum health per enemy damaged. Healing is halved against players.

name: Death Vortex
description: Create a persistent soul storm that damages and corrupts enemies.

name: Shield Bash
description: Drive forward for 1.7x damage, stun the first foe, and brace behind your shield.

name: Smite
description: Call a holy thunderbolt down on the toughest enemy nearby, with a holy splash — great against bosses and elites.

name: Taunt
description: Pull nearby foes to you and brace behind a shield.

name: Holy Ground
description: Scorch every foe around you with holy light for 2.2x damage.

name: Guard Up
description: Raise a holy shield that absorbs up to 50% of your max HP. Briefly plant your feet (0.3s); dodge to cancel the stance.

name: Light Burst
description: A radiant burst: damage and slow every nearby foe.

name: Last Stand
description: Brace for 4 seconds, reducing incoming damage and reflecting nearby hits. Immediately restore 15% of your maximum health.

name: Sky Hammer
description: Call a pillar of light down: heavy damage and knockback all around you.

name: Summon Skeletons
description: Raise a pack of skeletons that hunt down nearby enemies.

name: Plague Bolt
description: Rapid-fire bolts of necrotic plague (~2s, softer each).

name: Raise the Dead
description: Raise your most recently slain nearby enemy as an undead ally.

name: Corpse Nova
description: Detonate a burst of bone shards that slows nearby enemies.

name: Bone Wall
description: Raise a shield of bone that absorbs up to 35% of your max HP. Briefly plant your feet (0.3s); dodge to cancel the stance.

name: Death Grip
description: A skeletal grip implodes enemies inward and deals damage.

name: Army of the Dead
description: Raise a whole undead host at once to overwhelm the field. Briefly plant your feet (0.3s); dodge to cancel the stance.

name: Death Storm
description: A storm of decay rages around you for 4s.

name: Shadow Strike
description: Blink to the nearest enemy and strike for heavy damage.

name: Shuriken Barrage
description: Fire three back-to-back shotgun bursts of stars — shreds packs of enemies.

name: Shadow Step
description: Dash through shadow and become briefly untouchable.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Vanish in smoke (briefly invulnerable) and slow nearby foes.

name: Death Mark
description: Mark a target: it takes extra damage from you.

name: Piercing Star
description: Hurl one massive shuriken that pierces straight through — huge single-target damage for bosses.

name: Blade Fury
description: Deal 35% more damage and attack 30% faster for 6 seconds.

name: Vanish
description: Become invulnerable for 4 seconds and prepare your next teleporting basic hit immediately.

name: Blood Sweep
description: Spend 10% of your maximum health to sweep nearby enemies for 2.6 times weapon damage. Cannot be used if the cost would leave you below 2 HP.

name: Headbutt
description: Strike nearby enemies for 2.2 times weapon damage and stun them for 2.2 seconds. On a hit, spend 6% maximum health and pause for 0.5 seconds.

name: Charge
description: Rush forward, damaging and stunning in your path.

name: Shockwave
description: Slam the ground for damage and heavy knockback.

name: Whirlwind
description: Sweep all nearby enemies for 2.2 times weapon damage.

name: Execute
description: A brutal strike that finishes low-HP foes.

name: Berserk
description: Deal 35% more damage and attack 30% faster for 6 seconds.

name: Bloodguard
description: Raise a guard: heavy damage reduction and pull foes in.

name: Aimed Shot
description: Rapid piercing pistol shots (~2s, softer each) — a gunslinger's rhythm.

name: Broadside
description: A spread of shots across your front.

name: Boarding Strike
description: Dash to a foe and strike hard.

name: Roll
description: Roll back with a parting shot and snare.

name: Powder Smoke
description: Vanish in smoke and slow nearby foes.

name: Gold Rush
description: For 12s, every kill drops gold straight into your purse — and a killstreak stacks the payout higher and higher. The pirate's farming tool.

name: Cannonade
description: Mark foes — they explode on death.

name: Powder Keg
description: Drop a trap that damages and snares.

name: Time Bolt
description: Rapid-fire bolts of temporal energy (~2s, softer each).

name: Time Lance
description: A piercing lance through every foe.

name: Slow Field
description: A burst that slows nearby foes.

name: Time Step
description: Teleport forward with brief invulnerability. Your automatic death-saving rewind is a separate class ability.

name: Time Warp
description: Implode foes inward and deal damage.

name: Aegis
description: A shield that absorbs up to 35% of your max HP.

name: Stop Time
description: Stop enemies for 3 seconds. In PvP, slow opponents by 25% for up to 1.5 seconds instead of freezing their controls.

name: Singularity
description: A massive temporal explosion.

name: Flurry
description: Deliver rapid punches. Each connecting hit builds your temporary damage bonus.

name: Palm Strike
description: Dash in with a heavy palm that staggers the first foe.

name: Deflect
description: A parry stance: for a moment take almost nothing and throw blows straight back.

name: Roll
description: Roll aside with brief i-frames and a parting strike.

name: Whirl Kick
description: A spinning kick that strikes everything around you.

name: Stunning Palm
description: A shockwave palm that dazes and slows nearby foes.

name: Stillness
description: For 6 seconds, standing still reflects double incoming damage back to attackers. You still take damage.

name: Dragon Kick
description: A soaring kick that erupts on impact, blasting everything around.

name: Chain Bolt
description: Fire a quick lightning bolt with a short cooldown.

name: Lightning Lance
description: A piercing bolt through every foe in a line.

name: Thunder Step
description: Blink in a crack of lightning, briefly untouchable.

name: Static Field
description: A shock burst that slows nearby foes.

name: Ball Lightning
description: A crackling orb that pulls foes in and zaps them.

name: Storm Barrier
description: A shield that absorbs up to 35% of your max HP.

name: Linked Lightning
description: Link nearby enemies for 8 seconds. Hitting one also damages the others.

name: Chain Reaction
description: A massive electric explosion around your target.

name: Shadow Bolt
description: Fire a fast void bolt that pierces one extra foe.

name: Blood Lance
description: Hurl a heavy crimson lance through every foe in a line.

name: Curse Circle
description: Mark nearby foes for 7 seconds. Your damage against them is increased.

name: Life Drain
description: Damage the strongest nearby foe. Heal for 22% of health removed, or 11% against players. Blocked hits do not heal.

name: Rift Step
description: Blink forward and detonate shadow at your starting point and destination.

name: Doom Orb
description: Collapse a slow void orb on your target, damaging and pulling nearby foes.

name: Blood Offering
description: Spend half your current health to deal that much damage to every nearby enemy. Normal skill health cost also applies.

name: Final Curse
description: Condemn the strongest nearby foe with a massive delayed shadow blast.

name: Rising Spear
description: Sweep nearby enemies and launch high into the air.

name: Gale Shot
description: Fire a fast wind spear that grows stronger while airborne.

name: Dive Strike
description: Dive forward. Your next landing damages nearby enemies.

name: Wind Lift
description: Create a rising wind that damages foes and launches you upward.

name: Sky Dash
description: Dash through the air, damaging every enemy in your path.

name: Spear Rain
description: Call down five wind spears around your target.

name: Thunder Dive
description: Drop like lightning. Your next landing creates a large shockwave.

name: Updraft
description: Lift nearby normal enemies for 3.2 seconds and strike with a ring of wind blades.

name: Counter Stance
description: Open a short parry window. A hit during it deals no damage and stores a Riposte.

name: Twin Cut
description: Cut twice in a wide arc. The second cut pushes enemies back.

name: Riposte
description: Lunge and slash. A stored Riposte greatly increases its damage and reach.

name: Dance Step
description: Dash through enemies and turn to face them for your next attack.

name: Mirror Guard
description: Open a parry window that releases a shockwave when it catches an attack.

name: Cross Slash
description: Cut an X ahead of you and leave enemies briefly stunned.

name: Perfect Guard
description: Prepare a parry for up to 3 seconds. The first incoming hit is blocked and prepares an empowered Riposte.

name: Perfect Counter
description: Hold a long parry stance. Catching a hit unleashes a massive counterattack.

name: Sic 'Em
description: Your companion lunges for 1.6x damage and briefly stuns.

name: Coordinated Strike
description: You and your companion strike together; the target is marked for increased companion damage.

name: Guardian Bond
description: For 4s your companion intercepts part of incoming damage and gains a shield.

name: Pack Step
description: You and your companion dash to opposite sides of the target with brief dodge protection.

name: Mend the Pack
description: Restore 30% companion HP and 10% player HP over time.

name: Alpha Roar
description: A damaging roar slows nearby foes and turns their attention toward your companion.

name: Stampede
description: Call a spectral herd through a wide lane, striking and knocking enemies aside.

name: Apex Unleashed
description: For 8s your companion gains +35% damage/healing, +30% speed, and relentless pursuit.
